+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+
+from .core import Argument
+
+
+class CasefoldArgumentName(Argument):
+    """An :class:`Argument` that casefolds its normalized internal name
+    instead of lowercasing it. The external declaration is unchanged.
+    """
+
+    def _parse_decls(
+        self, decls: cabc.Sequence[str], expose_value: bool
+    ) -> tuple[str | None, list[str], list[str]]:
+        if not decls:
+            if not expose_value:
+                return None, [], []
+            raise TypeError("Argument is marked as exposed, but does not have a name.")
+        if len(decls) == 1:
+            name = arg = decls[0]
+            name = name.replace("-", "_").casefold()
+        else:
+            raise TypeError(
+                "Arguments take exactly one parameter declaration, got"
+                f" {len(decls)}: {decls}."
+            )
+        return name, [arg], []

@@ -0,0 +1,37 @@
+import pytest
+
+import click
+from click.casefold_argument_name import CasefoldArgumentName
+
+
+def test_casefolds_name():
+    arg = CasefoldArgumentName(["Straße-Name"])
+    assert arg.name == "strasse_name"
+    assert arg.opts == ["Straße-Name"]
+
+
+def test_not_exposed_without_name():
+    arg = CasefoldArgumentName([], expose_value=False)
+    assert arg.name is None
+    assert arg.opts == []
+
+
+def test_exposed_without_name_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="does not have a name"):
+        CasefoldArgumentName([])
+
+
+def test_multiple_decls_raises():
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="exactly one parameter declaration"):
+        CasefoldArgumentName(["a", "b"])
+
+
+def test_invoke(runner):
+    @click.command()
+    @click.argument("ẞig-Value", cls=CasefoldArgumentName)
+    def cli(ssig_value):
+        click.echo(ssig_value)
+
+    result = runner.invoke(cli, ["x"])
+    assert result.exit_code == 0, result.output
+    assert result.output == "x\n"
